items.title: Whatnot says its new terms include “the lowest commission rates in the industry”
items.summary: Whatnot just made a compelling offer to its community: The more they sell, the bigger their cut will be. That's the gist of Whatnot's updated commission rates, which bring a new financial structure to the live shopping platform.
